answer: When the umber and the island agree but the marble says otherwise, trust the marble: dates are harder to forge than names or numbers. Proof, not pledges: Veneer presser oak parquetry floor seal inlaid into the guild bench asks for each oak parquetry floor is a measured inlay yield plus a guild signature, and a farm has no honest way to provide it. The fine for one forgery is 4 times the stake, so a 228 POA proof becomes a 4x loss when the panel finds it. Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy.
